module: Silver Peak Unity EdgeConnect EC-XS-FIPS, EC-M-P-FIPS, EC-XL-P-FIPS and EC-XL-P-NM-FIPS
caveat: When operated in FIPS mode and with the tamper evident seals installed as indicated in the Security Policy
description: Unity EdgeConnect appliances deliver predictable application performance over any combination of transport services. Orchestrated application-driven security policies enable direct internet breakout for trusted SaaS and web applications. Fully compatible with existing WAN infrastructure, EdgeConnect provides simplifies and enables the Thin Branch.
allowed_algorithms: Diffie-Hellman (CVL Cert. #C1204, key agreement; key establishment methodology provides 112 bits of encryption strength); EC Diffie-Hellman (CVL Cert. #C1204 with CVL Cert. #C1204, key agreement; key establishment methodology provides between 112 and 256 bits of encryption strength); NDRNG; RSA (key wrapping; key establishment methodology provides 112 bits of encryption strength)
hardware_versions: EC-XS-FIPS[1], EC-M-P-FIPS[2], EC-XL-P-FIPS[3] and EC-XL-P-NM-FIPS[3] with FIPS Kit 500329-001[1], 500330-001[2] or 500331-001[3]

approved.note: AES Cert. #C1204 and HMAC Cert. #C1204; key establishment methodology provides 128 or 256 bits of encryption strength
